scripts.cli:install: npm run cli:build && node dist-cli/sharpplot.mjs bundle --out $HOME/.claude/tools/sharpplot
scripts.skill:pack: rm -rf dist-skill && mkdir -p dist-skill skills && cp -R .claude/skills/sharpplot dist-skill/sharpplot && (cd dist-skill && zip -r -X sharpplot.skill sharpplot -x '.*' > /dev/null) && rm -rf dist-skill/sharpplot && cp dist-skill/sharpplot.skill skills/sharpplot.skill && echo 'skills/sharpplot.skill (tracked) + dist-skill/sharpplot.skill (build output)'
scripts.skill:pack:cowork: npm run cli:build && rm -rf dist-skill/cowork dist-skill/sharpplot-cowork.skill && mkdir -p dist-skill/cowork/sharpplot/bin && cp -R .claude/skills/sharpplot/. dist-skill/cowork/sharpplot/ && cp dist-cli/*.mjs dist-skill/cowork/sharpplot/bin/ && cp node_modules/plotly.js-dist-min/plotly.min.js dist-skill/cowork/sharpplot/bin/ && (cd dist-skill/cowork && zip -q -r -X ../sharpplot-cowork.skill sharpplot -x '.*' '*/.*') && rm -rf dist-skill/cowork && ls -lh dist-skill/sharpplot-cowork.skill
scripts.team:pack: npm run cli:build && rm -rf dist-team && mkdir -p dist-team/'sharpplot for team' && cp -R skills/team-install/. dist-team/'sharpplot for team'/ && cp -R .claude/skills/sharpplot dist-team/'sharpplot for team'/sharpplot-skill && node dist-cli/sharpplot.mjs bundle --out dist-team/'sharpplot for team'/sharpplot-cli > /dev/null && echo 'dist-team/sharpplot for team/ — send this folder'
